content.title: Where to find Tax Day food deals around Minnesota
content.text: It’s a day when lots of chains dole out discounts.Apr 14, 2026 7:15 PM EDT It’s Tax Day, a day that, canonically, no one enjoys. Even if you’re ahead of the game and forgot that Tax Day exists, it’s here. Every year, the mid-April deadline prompts restaurants to offer some deals, which theoretically alleviates tax woes. Whether or not that’s true, a little discount on your lunch isn’t a bad thing. So, here are some spots around Minnesota where you can get a deal, whether it’s in recognition of the tax man’s birthday or just because the restaurant always has that deal on Wednesdays. La Doña CerveceriaLa Doña Cerveceria/Facebook Tax Day food deals at local restaurants La Doña CerveceríaThe deal: Take a dollar off beer in the taproom or to-go orders. When: Every Wednesday Litt Pinball BarThe deal: Any hot dog, smashburger, or sandwich plus chips and a soda will only run you $10 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.When: Monday–Friday Los OcampoThe deal: Get the Los Ocampo Burrito with chips and guac for $13.When: Every Wednesday Red CowThe deal: A half sandwich and half salad, soup, or side costs $15 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.When: Tuesday–Friday Stanley’s Northeast Bar RoomThe deal: In addition to lots of drink specials, an order of boneless wings will run you $10. Also, starting at 8 p.m., you can get a half-order of those wings, a burger, or chicken tenders for $7.When: April 15 Taqueria BravoThe deal: The annual Tax Day event in Sauk Centre, hosted by Winters Meier & Larson, will have the Taqueria Bravo food truck on site. The accounting company is covering $5 of every combo ordered.When: April 15 Up DownThe deal: The food isn’t discounted, but the Minneapolis arcade and bar has $3 domestic tallboys all night. When: Every Wednesday Krispy Kreme donutsKrispy Kreme Run Minnesota Tax Day food deals at chains Dickey’s Barbecue PitThe deal: Take $10 off an online order for at least $50 with the code “WRITEOFF.”When: April 14–15 Jersey Mike’s SubsThe deal: It’s not specifically tied to Tax Day, but its Boardwalk Bundle deal gets you a #2 sandwich, chips, and a 22-ounce fountain drink for $10.99.When: Ongoing Kona IceThe deal: Its Chill Out Day promotion lands you a free Kona Ice. Pretty straightforward. When: April 15 Krispy KremeThe deal: While Minnesota may only have one location, the deal still exists. Get a dozen Original Glazed donuts for free when you buy a dozen. When: April 15 Olive GardenThe deal: The “buy one take one” deal gets you a free take-home dish when you order one at regular price. (Those start at $15.)When: Ongoing Paris BaguetteThe deal: Get a free pastry with the purchase of any beverage through its rewards app. When: April 15 Pizza HutThe deal: Get a three-topping pizza starting at $10.When: April 15 PopeyesThe deal: Take 25% off a Tax Day 3-piece Tenders Combo when you order online or through the app. That includes three tenders, a side, a biscuit, and a drink. When: April 15 Portillo’sThe deal: Make a $5 purchase, and you get a $1 slice of cake. The catch is that you have to be a perks member, but it’s free to sign up.When: Through April 15 QdobaThe deal: Like with your taxes, this one takes a little planning. Through April 15, you can sign up for a reward at TaxDayGuacRelief.com. It’ll give you a $5 discount on any full-size entrée from April 20–26.When: Sign up by April 15 Smoothie KingThe deal: Get $3 off an order when you join its Healthy Rewards program by downloading the benevolant smoothie ruler’s app. When: April 15 White CastleThe deal: Use the code “WC15OFF” to get 15% off an order. When: Through April 16 Know of other Tax Day deals? Send ’em on over with a link to business@bringmethenews.com. About the authorDustin Nelson is BMTN's lead Minnesota food, music, events and lifestyle reporter.
